denied.title: 还没有资料库权限
denied.body: 航行资料库的访问权限由管理员（ADM）逐人授予，和管制评级是两回事 —— 有评级不等于有这里的权限。
denied.how: 需要的话，请联系一位 ADM 为你开通；他们在教员与管理门户的花名册上操作。

overview.title: 总览
overview.noData: 还没有任何数据集。先跑一次 aip-import。

airports.title: 机场
airports.description: {count} 个机场，来自当前生效的周期。
airports.notFound: 没有这个机场的当前数据。
airports.magneticNote: 跑道与机位航向是**磁**航向，写进 FSD 位置包前要用上面的磁差换算成真航向。
airports.runwayNote: Geometry comes from the nav data, dimensions and surface from the AIP — a runway may have only one half. Dimensions in metres.

map.title: Map
map.description: All 233 airports coloured by FIR. Overlay the airway network, and a FIR's fixes once you pick one.
map.empty: No active dataset, so there is nothing to draw.
map.fixesNeedFir: Pick a FIR first — all 15,278 fixes at once reads as noise.

route.title: Route planner
route.description: Plans over the directed airway network and lists every published restriction the route runs into.
route.restrictionsNote: Published text, unedited — judging whether it applies is yours.
route.unknownAirport: One of those identifiers is not in the current data — the request will fail.
route.scopeNote: “this leg” = the published segment is one this route flies; “same airway” = only the airway matches, the published segment is elsewhere on it. The compilation uses both forms, so both are listed.
route.sourcePublishedNote: This is the compilation's own routing for the pair, given as published.
route.sourceComputedNote: The compilation publishes no routing for this pair, so this is a shortest path over the airway network — it knows nothing of military activity areas or agreed routings.
route.alternatives: {n} more published routing(s) for this pair
route.airspacesNote: Prohibited areas are already routed around; these are restricted and danger areas. The activity times are published text, unparsed — crossing one is not the same as being unable to fly it today.

airportMap.title: Airport map
airportMap.suspectCount: {n} procedure points sit over 400 km from the field — most likely a misresolved identifier
airportMap.groundNone: No ground linework for this airport
airportMap.groundAccuracy: Traced from the aerodrome chart, placed to about {n} m
airportMap.groundUnchecked: No runway was available to check the fit — the whole layer may sit some 20 m off
airportMap.groundGuidanceHint: Guidance lines: runway and taxiway centrelines (unnamed)
airportMap.featuresHint: Hand-drawn: taxiways, stands, holding positions, with designators

fixes.title: 航路点
fixes.description: 按 FIR 浏览。**一个代号只在一个 FIR 内唯一** —— 全网有 267 个代号指向不止一个点，所以这里必须先选 FIR。
fixes.empty: 这个 FIR 没有航路点。
fixes.onMap: See this FIR on the map
fixes.truncated: {n} more not shown — narrow the search.

datasets.title: 数据集
datasets.description: 每一次导入都是一个数据集：一个来源、一个 AIRAC 周期，带着它自己的许可状态。

notFound.title: This page is off the charts
notFound.description: The page you asked for does not exist, or it may have moved since you last flew here.

procedures.altNote: Altitude constraints are the published ARINC 424 encoding (e.g. 05910B03940A), left undecoded — decoding one wrong is worse than not decoding it. FO = flyover, MAP = missed approach point.

positions.title: ATC positions
positions.description: {seats} published control positions across {units} units. One sector is one position.
positions.name: Name
positions.scopeNote: The compilation publishes area and approach only — tower, ground and delivery are not in it; those live in the aerodrome section as charts, not tables. Altitudes in metres.
positions.networkDescription: {seats} positions the network actually staffs, under {callsigns} login callsigns. From the sector packages — tower, ground, delivery and ATIS are all here.

ground.title: Ground data
ground.handNote: Hand-drawn from charts and imagery; metre-level.
ground.chartNote: Chart linework traced from the aerodrome chart, placed to about {n} m.
ground.unchecked: no runway was available to check this chart — the layer may sit some 20 m off
ground.none: No ground data for this airport yet
ground.noneWhy: The compilation publishes no stand-coordinate table for it (georeferencing needs stand numbers), and nobody has drawn it by hand.
